amendments.reason: S4 PART 10: the S4 measurement-closure (measurement_complete=true, runtime-admission unmeasured) was premature. S5 opened the admission timer BEFORE the runtime_admission() call, deployed the corrected build 03881b2b, and ran a fresh 10-problem current-arm battery on that build. The fresh SYNTHESIZE-purpose decomposition now shows admission_s mean=0.528 s and a near-zero unattributed remainder (mean 0.002 s, max 0.003 s), proving the admission wall was actually measured and no longer rides the remainder. The prior S4 closure state is preserved byte-identical (amended_from_sha256) and superseded by this fresh corrected-build execution; the no-optimization classification stands.
